notes: Initial thesis: move from prototype (self-hosted embeddings) -> Redwood hosted API for fast ramp -> Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost
Primary contact: CTO Maya Liu (data platform). Product lead: Carlos Vega.
Key constraints: nightly batch ingestion of full corpus (~10M docs), incremental daily adds (~100k vectors), retention policy 3y, EU data residency for EU customers.
Performance targets: online semantic-search p95 latency < 120ms for top-5 retrieval; sustained QPS target 150 for search queries; batch ingestion throughput target 200k vectors/hour during windows.
Vector DB stance: prefer Pinecone for prototype, evaluating Milvus for Dedicated/on-prem long term. Must validate Redwood connector to both (upsert, bulk import, namespace isolation).
Cost sensitivity: pricing target ~ $75k-$150k ARR with committed capacity; tight cost per 1M embedding units vs current self-hosted GPU spend.
Security ask: SOC2 + SSO (SAML) required before procurement; audit logs and KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated offering.
Quote from call: 'If we can get reliable <120ms for top-k and predictable monthly cost, this displaces our current HomeGrown vector stack' — Maya L.

POC scope agreed: (1) Hosted API pilot for 2 weeks with sample traffic; (2) Dedicated 2-week POC with reserved pool, ingest 10M vectors via S3->Redwood bulk import -> vector DB; (3) measure cold-cache retrieval and nightly reindex window.
Tech notes: need support for batched embedding endpoints, async bulk import APIs, and backpressure handling on long indexing jobs. SE to provide ingestion runner examples (Python + Airflow snippets).
Open questions: fallback model behavior for outages, recommended quantization profile for cost/perf tradeoff, how KV-prefix caching interacts with vector search latency.
Internal alignment: Growth wants PLG experience (hosted api) first; Platform team pushing Dedicated for multi-tenant isolation and contractual SLAs.

Decision criteria: 1) integration smoothness with existing ETL and vector DB; 2) sustained throughput and latency under production mix; 3) cost per MAU and committed price; 4) security/compliance checklist completion.
Budget timeline: legal + procurement expect term sheet by 2026-04; AE to push mid-March pricing update to align with company's fiscal quarter close.
Win signals: successful ingest of 10M vectors in <36h, p95 search latency <120ms in Dedicated POC, signed SOC2 attestation available.
Failure signals: repeated >250ms p95 for top-5, inability to support incremental upserts without significant downtime, or price >200k ARR.

use_case_summary: EmbedFlow is a mid-market product analytics SaaS building in semantic search and recommendations across product metrics and help docs. They need a path from Hosted API for speed-to-value to Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and cost. POC focuses on bulk embedding ingestion, vector DB integration (Pinecone/Milvus), nightly reindex jobs, and meeting p95 latency targets under 150ms.
technical_requirements: Bulk import: S3 -> Redwood ingestion with idempotent upserts
Incremental updates: support daily delta of ~100k vectors without full reindex
Vector DB integration: validated connectors for Pinecone and Milvus (namespace isolation, upsert/bulk, TTL)
Embedding throughput: support 200k vectors/hour in batch window; online embed latency <80ms
Search latency: p95 <120ms for top-5 on Dedicated under 150 QPS mixed traffic
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, tracing
Security: SAML SSO, KMS integration for keys, audit logging and retention controls
